name: Refraction
description: Refracts incoming damage onto a random adjacent unit instead, up to %count% time per turn. With no adjacent unit to absorb it, the damage lands as normal.

upgrade.summary: Gains a second refraction each turn, at %second_efficiency:pct%% strength.
upgrade.description: Refracts incoming damage onto a random adjacent unit instead, up to %count% times per turn. With no adjacent unit to absorb it, the damage lands as normal.
details: The first refraction of a turn passes the whole blow on. The second passes only %second_efficiency:pct%% of it, and this unit takes the rest.
